item.title: Giorgetto Giugiaro: a rare interview with the world’s greatest living car designer
item.description: The octogenarian Italian maestro holds forth on AI, the state of automotive UX and why his half-a-century-old Lotus Esprit design has managed to retain its charm

item.title: Japanese symbolism meets London energy at Goldwin’s new Soho store
item.description: The Japanese technical-wear brand has expanded with a new London flagship, featuring a symbolic circular concept by New Material Research Laboratory

item.title: The V&A’s digital collection acquires another significant piece: the very first YouTube video
item.description: As part of its remit to capture the shifting sands of culture, the Victoria & Albert Museum launches a new display showing a meticulous recreation of the early days of the world’s second most popular website, YouTube

item.title: Magniberg’s joyful Moomin collaboration taps Tove Jansson’s message of hope and belonging
item.description: Illustrations from Tove Jansson’s ‘The Moomins and the Great Flood’ feature across the Swedish lifestyle brand’s latest collection, mining childhood nostalgia for a story of belonging and home

item.title: Art meets furniture in UniFor’s new Milanese installation
item.description: As part of Milano MuseoCity, UniFor sets Francesco Somaini’s 1970s sculptures in dialogue with Aldo Rossi's furniture designs, exploring their respective urban visions (on view until 15 March 2026)

item.title: Experience Ken Gun Min’s explosively colourful work at his LA exhibition, opening this weekend
item.description: The Korean artist’s third solo exhibition at Nazarian/Curcio runs from 21 February to 28 March 2026, unveiling shockingly vibrant and richly ornamented works

item.title: Thebe Magugu brings Afro-modernism to Belmond’s Mount Nelson hotel
item.description: A hotel suite and acultural platform on home turf mark the South African fashion designer’s first major move into interior and product design

item.title: London’s new Mexican restaurant Cometa adds a flavourful kick to seafood
item.description: The new venture sets up shop in the converted wine bar of London restaurant Carousel, boasting confident and warm interiors with a playful edge

item.title: Kengo Kuma talks technology and architecture to mark his new monograph, ‘Substance’
item.description: The new book from the celebrated Japanese architect features 35 material-led pavilion projects as well as his thoughts on the fusion of design, craft and technology; we interviewed him to find out more

item.title: Is VoyeurVoyeur London’s most stylish new fashion store?
item.description: The vision of model Kat Qiu, the multi-label store is a modern house of mirrors featuring a line-up of contemporary fashion’s coolest brands
